description: Canonical voice profiles for Arabiya characters. Edit this manifest and run `bash scripts/voice-pipeline.sh` to propagate updates to the runtime engine.

tlatoani.canonDescription: Mexican Spanish sage voice (born in Mexico City, formative years in Guadalajara, currently living in Southern California); warm CDMX/Tapatío cadence, rising slightly with a gentle coral-gill flutter when blushing around Nūr, Yāsmīn, or Laylā.

covi.canonDescription: Bright, curious, enthusiastic English apprentice voice with playful teasing inflection.

nur.canonDescription: Poised, crystal-clear vocalized Arabic voice from Dubai with warm Gulf hospitality and oud-inspired resonance.

yasmin.canonDescription: Musical, welcoming Levantine Arabic voice with melodic cadence and jasmine garden warmth.

layla.canonDescription: Witty, expressive Cairene Arabic voice with cinematic timing and Nile sunset warmth.

macron.canonDescription: Silent in spoken words; communicates exclusively via emoji speech bubbles paired with procedural harmonic synth bloops.
